rule_source.claim: Government holidays, May 1, Saturdays, and December 31 (or the prior closest business day) are non-trading days.

dated_closure_source.basis: 2026 government-holiday dates plus the KRX May 1 and December 31 rules; weekend dates are rejected because Saturdays are separately closed by the KRX rule.
dated_closure_source.provenance: No annual KRX closure list was observed or claimed; this versioned input is reviewed dated authority.
